author: reek
body: Design variant overlay on schematic properties. Extends the core DesignVariants module with schematic-specific logic: typed variant properties, diff computation between a variant and baseline, BOM filtering for DNP components, and human-readable summaries.

author: reek
body: The property being overridden in a variant. VpValue changes the component value (e.g. 100k to 47k). VpFootprint changes the package. VpDnp marks do-not-populate. VpPopulated reverses a DNP. VpCustom carries an arbitrary field name and value.

author: reek
body: A single property change within a variant, recording the component reference, the property being changed, and both the original and variant values for diffing and reporting.

author: reek
body: The computed difference between a variant and the baseline design. Contains all changes, plus summary counts.

author: reek
body: A lightweight component record used as input to diff computation. Carries the reference designator and its baseline field values.

author: reek
body: A schematic-level override record pairing a component reference with a typed variant property.

author: reek
body: Build a VariantDiff by walking each override and looking up the baseline component to determine original values.

author: reek
body: Given a list of all component references and a variant diff, return only those references that are NOT marked do-not-populate in this variant. A component is DNP if the diff contains a change for that ref with property "dnp" and variant-value "1".

author: reek
body: Return all changes in a diff that apply to a given reference designator.
